content: {DRAFT} When LdCom_CopyTxData and LdCom_TpTxConfirmation are invoked, LdCom shall use the passed PDU Id as Handle Id (LdComHandleId ECUC_LdCom_00005 ) to derive the corresponding <LdCo mUser_LdComCbkCopyTxData> or <LdComUser_LdComCbkTpTxConfir - mation> user notification callback and call it with the according LdCom user callback handle Id.
